timeline.event: Release 4.35.3 of the search indexer starts rolling out to production.
Error rates on the search indexer begin to climb.
The SearchIndexLagCritical alert fires and pages the on-call engineer.
Olu Petrakis acknowledges the page and opens an incident channel.
The team decides to roll back release 4.35.3.
The rollback completes and error rates return to baseline.
Ama Brennan declares the incident resolved after monitoring stays clean.

root_cause: Release 4.35.3 changed the index mapping, so the indexer rejected documents with the old field type and search results went stale.
contributing_factors: The mapping change had no migration step in the deploy checklist.
The lag alert threshold was set high enough that it fired only after customers noticed.
went_well: The rollback runbook worked first time.
went_badly: Detection relied on a single alert with a high threshold.
Nobody owned the shared config file that changed.

action_items.action: Run canary stages at peak traffic, not off-peak
Add a review rule for changes to the shared config file
Lower the alert threshold and add a second, symptom-based alert
